caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a woman standing on a rectangular pedestal. She is dressed in a reddish-brown dress with green and blue accents, and a wide green sash tied at her waist. The woman is wearing a headdress made up of several brown and tan feathers that extend upward and outward from her head. Her left arm is bent at the elbow and raised, holding a bundle of brown objects, while her right arm is extended forward, holding a rectangular yellow box. The statue stands with her left foot forward on a small, raised platform on top of the main pedestal, and her right foot placed lower. The pedestal is blue with red borders and has the word "CIGARS" in large yellow letters on its front. The background is plain and beige. The artist’s signature, “Ch. Bowman,” is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
